The Van Kush Beauty Token (VKBT) is a cryptocurrency token within the [[Van Kush Family]] ecosystem, primarily operating on the [[Hive Engine and Smart Media Tokens|HIVE-Engine]] platform<ref>cryptocurrency/cryptocurrency/hive_engine_ecosystem.json</ref><ref>vankush/vankush/van_kush_crypto_network.json</ref>. It is described as a primary token for teaching trading and earning<ref>cryptocurrency/cryptocurrency/hive_engine_ecosystem.json</ref>.

== Platform and Creation ==
VKBT is based on the [[Hive Engine and Smart Media Tokens|HIVE-Engine]] smart contract side-chain platform<ref>cryptocurrency/cryptocurrency/hive_engine_ecosystem.json</ref>. It is also noted to be on BLURT platforms<ref>vankush/vankush/complete_vankush_synthesis.json</ref>. The token is activated on the @kalivankush HIVE account<ref>vankush/vankush/van_kush_crypto_network.json</ref>. Kali Van Kush is identified as a co-founder of the [[Van Kush Family|Van Kush Family Research Institute]] and is involved in the Van Kush Beauty economy and social media<ref>vankush/vankush/vankush_family_master_synthesis.json</ref>.

== Utility and Purpose ==
The VKBT serves multiple purposes within the [[Van Kush Family]] community:
*   **Rewards** It is used to reward Van Kush Beauty customers and community members<ref>vankush/vankush/van_kush_crypto_network.json</ref>.
*   **Discounts** Holders can receive product discounts<ref>vankush/vankush/van_kush_crypto_network.json</ref>.
*   **Community Governance** It facilitates community voting<ref>vankush/vankush/van_kush_crypto_network.json</ref>.
*   **Staking** The token offers staking rewards<ref>vankush/vankush/van_kush_crypto_network.json</ref>.
*   **Education** It is a primary token for teaching trading and earning<ref>cryptocurrency/cryptocurrency/hive_engine_ecosystem.json</ref>.

Within the Institute's framework, VKFRI proposes a "Beauty Economy" concept, where mining outputs support real-world social and aesthetic structures<ref>vankush/vankush/van_kush_crypto_network.json</ref>. This includes funding Van Kush Beauty products, temple construction, and community support, integrating crypto earnings to fund physical world improvements<ref>vankush/vankush/van_kush_crypto_network.json</ref>.

== Ecosystem Integration ==
The [[Van Kush Family]] has plans for cross-chain expansion for VKBT. There is a plan to make VKBT utilizable on both [[Hive Engine and Smart Media Tokens|HIVE-Engine]] and Polygon (MATIC)<ref>cryptocurrency/cryptocurrency/hive_engine_ecosystem.json</ref>. This initiative aims to provide cross-chain liquidity without requiring users to leave the HIVE ecosystem<ref>cryptocurrency/cryptocurrency/hive_engine_ecosystem.json</ref>. The expansion to Polygon (MATIC) is also intended to broaden VKBT's accessibility<ref>cryptocurrency/cryptocurrency/cure_token_documentation.json</ref>.

VKBT is also connected to other tokens and projects within the [[Van Kush Family]] ecosystem:
*   **[[CURE Token]]** Cross-chain expansion plans aim to expand the accessibility of both CURE and VKBT<ref>cryptocurrency/cryptocurrency/cure_token_documentation.json</ref>.
*   **Terracore** Within the [[Van Kush Family]]'s investment strategy for the Terracore game, profits from VKBT and MATIC are planned to be used to purchase $SCRAP, the native currency of Terracore<ref>cryptocurrency/cryptocurrency/terracore_play2earn.json</ref>.
